description: Mark or unmark a tracked keyword as favorite for a specific app. Favorites are stored per tracking row (profile + app + keyword), so a keyword tracked across multiple apps has independent favorite states. Both keyword_id and app_id come from list_keywords results.

app_id.description: The application internal ID (numeric, from list_keywords results)

is_favorite.description: true to mark as favorite, false to unmark

keyword_id.description: The keyword internal ID (numeric, from list_keywords results)

name: set_keyword_favorite
